concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-reporting-to-adyen]] — 2024-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Capital-platform immediate notification, conditional quarterly Adyen-product complaints reporting and UK/Ireland aggregate vulnerability totals/annual patterns; not legal advice or submission proof.
warnings: Immediate notification is stated as within 1–2 business days; quarterly reporting is conditional on applicable law and starts at first live user onboarding.
UK/Ireland section says only total figures for vulnerable users are required; do not infer individual sensitive-data transfer.
Captured quarter dates and email are historical instructions, not proof of current delivery channel or fulfilled reporting.
